relationships.subject: Maresin-2
relationships.evidence_quote: MaR-2 was able to reduce to sham levels the number of CGRP/p-NFκB positive neurons (P < 0.0001).

relationships.subject: Maresin-2
relationships.evidence_quote: MaR-2 reduced significantly the number of c-Fos positive cells compared to samples of CCI-ION mice treated with vehicle

relationships.subject: CCI-ION
relationships.evidence_quote: mice subjected to CCI-ION present a significant increase in c-Fos activation in the TG compared to the sham group

relationships.subject: CGRP 8-37
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment of CCI-ION rats with CGRP 8–37 resulted in anti-hyperalgesic effect at 30 min up to 2 h compared to vehicle-treated CCI-ION rats

key_findings: Medullary subarachnoid MaR-2 reduced formalin nociception, post-operative hyperalgesia and CCI-ION neuropathic hyperalgesia in rats and mice.
MaR-2 restored c-Fos+ and CGRP+/p-NFkB+ trigeminal ganglion neuron counts to sham levels.
